acceptance: A test or CI step verifies that modifying a file with a pinned notice requires updating the SHA/digest in quality/comment-cleanup-scope.json.
context: Uncovered during comment-policy checker review followups (follow-up item 5). PR #2622 previously changed _sources/tpc-h/PATCHES.md without updating the pin digest in quality/comment-cleanup-scope.json.
description: A whole-file pinned notice in quality/comment-cleanup-scope.json (such as _sources/tpc-h/PATCHES.md) is verified against its recorded digest in the comment-policy validator, but there is no guard preventing changes to the pinned file from landing without an accompanying pin update in the scope manifest. Add a pre-commit or CI guard asserting that any branch touching a whole-file pinned notice updates the corresponding digest pin in quality/comment-cleanup-scope.json.
